title: What are you going to do?
subtitle: Winter break plans — be going to
canDo: I can talk about my plans with going to.
I can ask other people about their plans.
I can understand a short article about plans.
teacherNotes: A2'nin ilk dersi: talimatlarda artık Türkçe/Arapça çeviri yok. İlk derslerde talimatları siz sesli okuyun, gerekirse açıklayın.
going to'yu "önceden kararlaştırılmış plan" olarak verin; will ile karşılaştırmaya (Ünite 8) şimdilik girmeyin.
Konuşma: öğrenciler birbirine "What are you going to do this weekend / in the summer?" diye sorsun, going to ile cevaplasın.
Mei yeni bir yan karakter: sınıftaki Çinli öğrenci (A1'de adı geçmeden bahsedilmişti).

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: Six weeks to go
sections.scene: A Saturday in November. Elif is working at Sam's café. Her friends come in for coffee.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: So, the winter break starts in six weeks. What are you all going to do?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: I'm going to fly to Amman on December 20th. I'm going to stay for two weeks.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Lovely! Your mum is going to be very happy.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Yes! And my grandmother is going to cook for the whole family.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Blue Monday is going to play in New York! Three concerts in one week.

lines.text: Wow! Are you going to take the bus with the drum again?

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Ha ha. No, this time Jake is going to drive.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm going to visit my parents in Florida. It's warm there, and they live near the beach.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: And you, Sam? Are you and Emma going to travel?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: What about you, Elif? Are you going to go home to Izmir?

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Winter break: what are you going to do?
sections.intro: Elif asked people at Harbor English School about their plans. Here is her article for the school newsletter.
paragraphs: The winter break starts on December 20th, and everyone at Harbor English School has plans.
Omar is going to fly home to Amman. “I'm going to eat my grandmother's food every day,” he says. “And I'm not going to cook for two weeks!”
Maya, our teacher, is going to visit her parents in Florida. She's going to swim in the sea every morning and read a lot of books.
Lucas and his band, Blue Monday, are going to play three concerts in New York. Jake, the drummer, is going to drive.
“We're going to leave on December 22nd and come back before the New Year,” says Lucas.
Mei, our classmate from China, is going to stay in Boston. She's going to work in her uncle's restaurant.
And me? I'm not sure yet. The tickets to Izmir are very expensive, so maybe I'm going to stay here too.
But one thing is sure: I'm going to sleep a lot!

sections.title: Grammar: be going to
look: I**'m going to fly** to Amman.
**Are** you **going to go** home to Izmir?
rules: **be going to** + verb: plans and decisions for the future.
Time words: **tonight, tomorrow, next week, next month, in six weeks, on December 20th**.
Short answers: Are you going to stay? — Yes, I **am**. / No, I**'m not**.
With go, you can say *I'm going to go to Florida* or just *I'm going to Florida*.
examples: I'm going to visit my parents.
We aren't going to travel this year.
Is Lucas going to play in New York?
What are you going to do next weekend?

support.tr: be going to, önceden karar verilmiş planlar içindir (Türkçede -ecek / -acak): I'm going to fly to Amman = Amman'a uçacağım. Yapı: am / is / are + going to + fiil. Olumsuz: I'm not going to cook = Yemek yapmayacağım. Soru: Are you going to stay? = Kalacak mısın? in six weeks = altı hafta sonra ("altı haftada" değil).
support.ar: نستخدم be going to للخطط والقرارات المسبقة (سوف / سـ): I'm going to fly to Amman = سأسافر إلى عمّان. التركيب: am / is / are + going to + الفعل. النفي: I'm not going to cook = لن أطبخ. السؤال: Are you going to stay? = هل ستبقى؟ و in six weeks = بعد ستّة أسابيع.

tr.note: am / is / are'yi unutma; going to'dan sonra fiil yalın kalır.
wrong: I going to visit my family.
She's going to flies to Amman.
right: I'm going to visit my family.
She's going to fly to Amman.

ar.note: لا تنسَ to بعد going، و«بعد ستّة أسابيع» = in six weeks (وليس after).
wrong: The break starts after six weeks.
right: The break starts in six weeks.

sections.title: Practice
sections.instructions: Complete with be going to and the verb.
items: Next week, I {am going to visit|'m going to visit} my aunt. (visit)
Omar {is going to fly|'s going to fly} to Amman on December 20th. (fly)
We {aren't going to travel|are not going to travel} this year. (not travel)
{Are} you going to stay in Boston? — Yes, I am.
What {is} Maya going to do in Florida? — She's going to swim.
Lucas and Jake {are going to play|'re going to play} in New York. (play)

sections.title: Write: Next weekend

model.heading: Next weekend — Lina
text: Next weekend is going to be very busy.
On Friday, we're going to visit Grandma Fatima, as always.
I'm going to help her in the kitchen.
On Saturday morning, I'm going to study for my last exam.
In the evening, my friends and I are going to see a film at the cinema.
I'm not going to sleep much!

frame: On Sunday, I'm going to ___ with ___.
sections.prompt: What are you going to do next weekend? Write 5 to 7 sentences.
checklist: I use going to five times.
I use one negative: I'm not going to …
I use time words: on Saturday, in the evening.
